channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Slovakia Lead Group B Over Finland, Sweden, Italy After Two Wins
item.description: In a group with gold medal contenders Sweden and Finland, it's Slovakia that rank first after two games.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: A Mammoth Trade Could Be Coming, Plus Latest Penguins And Blue Jackets Buzz
item.description: The Utah Mammoth, Pittsburgh Penguins and Columbus Blue Jackets could make moves before the NHL trade deadline to improve their chances of clinching playoff berths.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Finland Go To War With Sweden – And Win
item.description: Finnish hockey superstar Mikko Rantanen says Team Finland plays "grinding, physical, in-your-face hockey." That was on display to its fullest extent in a vicious game against Sweden at the Olympics.

item.title: Maple Leafs' William Nylander Is All-In At The Olympics: 'I'm Just Managing, But I'm Feeling Good'
item.description: William Nylander has missed 17 of the Toronto Maple Leafs' games this season due to injuries. But he won't miss any of Sweden's high-stakes games from now on at the Olympics if he can help it.

item.title: Six NHL Teams That Will Benefit The Most From The Olympic Break
item.description: While some teams have plenty of representation at the 2026 Olympics in Milan, other clubs will have an opportunity to come back from the break well-rested. Here are six NHL teams that will benefit from this break the most.

item.title: NHL Calder Trophy Tracker: Islanders' Schaefer And Canadiens' Demidov Look Like Olympians Already
item.description: New York Islanders and Montreal Canadiens rookies Matthew Schaefer and Ivan Demidov continue to lead the way in the NHL Calder Trophy race at the Olympic break. When will this year's rookies become Olympians?

item.title: Canada's Connor McDavid Challenges Single-Olympic Record For Most Points By An NHLer
item.description: Team Canada's Connor McDavid is already halfway to breaking the record for most points by an NHL player in a single Olympics tournament. But as Canada clinches Group A, McDavid's not here for the record.

item.title: 'I Feel Terribly': Switzerland, Canada Wish Kevin Fiala The Best After Leaving Game On Stretcher
item.description: Players from Canada and Switzerland left the bench to tap their sticks as Swiss star Kevin Fiala left the final moments of their round-robin game on a stretcher with what appeared to be a lower-body injury.

item.title: What Is Team Sweden Doing With Filip Forsberg At The Olympics?
item.description: Team Sweden's Olympic hockey coach is making some bewildering ice time choices when it comes to the minimal ice time for Filip Forsberg, writes Adam Proteau.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: Reacting To Canada And Finland's Friday Wins At Olympics
item.description: From Milan, Ryan Kennedy helps break down Canada and Finland's wins in men's hockey action on Friday with Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello.
